items.headline: David Bailey delivers breakthrough performance in Jets' win
items.description: Desperate to get back in the win column on Sunday, the New York Jets were lifted 23-year-old rookie David Bailey, who delivered his breakthrough performance, recording three sacks and eight quarterback pressures, in a 17-12 win over the Cleveland Browns.
